'''Sybilla''' is a female NPC who appears in {{Location|Porto-Veno Castle|nocat=1}} at night. She works as a maid for [[Fisalia Family]].

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Sybilla:''' Did I just see fish swimming by...?
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Sybilla:''' Did I just see fish swimming by...?
:{{DIcon}} I saw it too.
:'''Sybilla:''' Oh my!
:{{DIcon}} Sorry, did I scare you?
:'''Sybilla:''' My apologies, honored guest. It's just that the atmosphere in the mansion at night... well, I'm not as brave as [[Fiore]].
:'''Sybilla:''' Probably just the shadow of some deep-sea fish kept somewhere in the mansion... Yes, that must be it!
:{{DIcon}} Is this part of the Fisalia's family business?
:'''Sybilla:''' Well, this is a recent side venture of ours. Our main business is still gathering deep-sea plants and extracting their essences to make medicines.
:'''Sybilla:''' We've practically cornered the potion trade in Ragunna and [[Septimont]].
:'''Sybilla:''' You know, I overheard someone say there are... unexpected discoveries to be made while gathering the plants.
:{{DIcon}} Unexpected discoveries?
:'''Sybilla:''' That's right. Some of them are shipwrecks mentioned in old records. Salvage something like that, well...
:'''Sybilla:''' Let's just say you could fetch an amount I'm not allowed to disclose. Heh.
{{Dialogue End}}
